title: A. E. has been telling some yankee interviewer.
html_source: Stephen recalls O'Molloy’s statement from earlier that day.

anchor.text: A. E. has been telling some yankee interviewer.
anchor.prefix: Shelley, the words of Hamlet bring our minds into contact with the eternal 1932#165wisdom, Plato's world of ideas. All the rest is the speculation of schoolboys for schoolboys.
anchor.suffix:
Wall, tarnation strike me! 

 — The schoolmen were schoolboys first, Stephen said superpolitely. Aristotle was once Plato's schoolboy. 

 — And has remained so, one should hope, J
